parameters.name: Async
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous link to stop the job.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to obtain the cluster ID.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The job ID.

You can call the [ListJobs](~~87251~~) operation to obtain the job ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc describe-job --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --job-id 1.scheduler0000 --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
